cards.text:
DZ-PS02/001EN
Revenger, Raging Form Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Shadow Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 11000｜ Shield
[AUTO](VC)[Limit-Break 4]:At the end of the battle this unit attacked, [COST][retire three rear-guards with "Revenger" in their card names], choose up to one "Revenger, Raging Form Dragon" from your hand, ride it as [Stand], choose one of your vanguards, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of that battle.
[CONT](VC/RC):Lord (If you have a unit without a same clan as this unit, this unit cannot attack)

DZ-PS02/002EN
Revenger, Raging Fall Dragon "Яeverse"
Normal Unit｜ Shadow Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[ACT](VC):[COST][Lock a rear-guard with "Revenger" in its card name], choose three of your units with "Revenger" in their card names, and they get [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:This ability's cost is reduced by [Counter-Blast 1] for each of your locked cards. At the end of the battle this unit attacked, [COST][Counter-Blast 3 & discard three cards from hand], choose up to two of your [Stand] rear-guards, and lock them. Then, if you have two or more locked cards or five cards in your damage zone, [Stand] this unit.

DZ-PS02/003EN
Revenger, Dragruler Phantom
Normal Unit｜ Shadow Paladin｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed by riding from a unit with "Revenger" in its card name during the ride phase, search your deck for up to one card with "Revenger" in its card name, call it to (RC) and shuffle the deck. If your opponent's damage zone has four or less cards, [COST][Soul-Blast 1] "Illusionary Revenger, Mordred Phantom"], choose one of your opponent's vanguards, and deal one damage.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], choose all of your front row "Blaster Dark" and front row units with "Revenger" in their card names, retire all of your other rear-guards, and for each unit retired, all of your front row units get [Power] +5000 until end of turn. If you retired two or more rear-guards, [Stand] all of your front row rear-guards.

DZ-PS02/004EN
Revenger, Slay Hex Dragon

[AUTO]:When this unit is placed by riding from a unit with "Revenger" in its card name, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & discard a card from hand], search your deck for up to one "Revenger, Raging Form Dragon", ride it as [Stand], and shuffle the deck. If you rode a card, choose a "Revenger, Slay Hex Dragon" from your soul, and put it into hand.

At the end of that turn, retire that unit.

At the end of that turn, put that unit on the bottom of the deck.

[AUTO]:When this unit is retired from (RC) by your card's ability, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], your opponent chooses one of their rear-guards, and retires it.

[ACT](RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 2], choose a grade 2 with "Revenger" in its card name from your drop, and call it to a (RC) in the same column as this unit.

G Unit｜ ｜ Grade 4｜ Power 16000+｜ Shield

[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), choose any number of your locked cards, and unlock them. Choose the same number of cards from your hand as the number of cards unlocked by this effect, and discard them.
[AUTO](VC)/G Zone:When this unit is placed on (VC), or at the beginning of your turn, if this card is face up, your damage zone has two or less cards, and no new card was put into your damage zone during your opponent's preceding turn, [COST][put the top card of the deck into damage zone], and draw a card.
